design: Exploratory paired reconstruction on existing clean simulated trajectories, with new noise seeds101/307/911. Fixed hyperparameters are recorded before this campaign, but the flow families and H+k10 prior were inspected in earlier campaigns; this is not independent blind held-out confirmation. Clean velocity is used only for injection amplitude and evaluation. Every estimator receives observed velocity and times only; postprocessing receives geometry only. Equal20%RMS does not make noise distributions equally difficult.
scope: Seven 128x128 velocity trajectories, five noises, three seeds and ten methods: 1050 raw fits and 3150 evaluations of those fits. H and H+k10 never refit an estimator. Non-Newtonian stresses and conformation are not reconstructed by these velocity-only estimators.
cost_scope: One single-BLAS-thread isolated child per fit; fit and postprocess CPU/wall/RSS profiles are separate from evaluation. Absolute child RSS includes runtime and inherited observations/reference. Timing is descriptive on a shared host; no repeated-cost uncertainty is claimed. Postprocess RSS is the accumulated child lifetime peak and may inherit prior fit/evaluation peaks; it is not incremental projection memory.
